lxc_4fb3577bb9e362f8.text: After a flight, it is normal to need a little help.

lxc_30a00472b77b141d.text: At Guam airport, car rental and tour counters are near baggage claim.

lxc_e4dcb08d47063ea3.text: Hotel phones are near the customs exit.

lxc_89d5c60c26e860b1.text: These are different places, so name the service you need.

lxc_2c035ca2599d10d5.text: If you want to contact your hotel, ask for the hotel phones.

lxc_e602b42eaa353c09.text: If you want a taxi, ask for the counter outside West Arrival.

lxc_aaee13d96e7df0a5.text: You can start with a simple question and explain your reason.

lxc_741eef57e95f2527.text: For example, you may need to ask your hotel about a transfer.

lxc_99f48cb01afc14b5.text: Thank the person who helps you.

lxc_bd2ea6ed76fd6127.text: A short, friendly exchange can make arrival feel easier.

lxc_bff32a6ffe54e4bc.text: Imagined hotel check-in: You meet Rosa, a receptionist, at an unnamed hotel in Tumon after the short taxi ride from Guam airport.

lxc_c956f783385ba3f6.text: Your taxi used a meter; this check-in and all personal details are an imagined exchange, not a real hotel's procedure.

lxc_295e9a9e3c5d07e6.text: Your goal is to complete the imagined check-in and tell Rosa where you are from, what you do, and what kind of holiday you want.

lxc_4767be2502e3b38d.text: You have your bags, and you are ready to leave Guam airport.

lxc_e9bdec0b4bbd9f30.text: The taxi counter is outside West Arrival.

lxc_d16aede6cf1eccb4.text: Tumon hotels are a short taxi ride from the airport.

lxc_61e350b31a31875b.text: Ask about the fare before you leave.

lxc_0f3f68e987c0a986.text: Taxis use meters, so do not guess the cost.

lxc_aa850c6b8743a229.text: A hotel transfer may be another choice.

lxc_f51002b2b4897490.text: Many Tumon hotels offer courtesy airport transfers, but you need to confirm this when you book.

lxc_c13dcf2d030ba4ed.text: Do not assume your hotel has one.

lxc_c82cb1d54075f67d.text: Tell the driver your hotel name, and keep the address ready.

lxc_e4f3bc7371d37c79.text: A clear destination helps you begin the trip with less worry and enjoy your first conversation.

lxc_2945c84171b2263c.text: “I need to call my hotel about a transfer.”

lxc_efd244b5b691b4e7.text: “Are you here for work or a holiday?”

lxc_ab2265979de16391.text: Your airport trip ends when you reach your hotel, but another conversation begins.

lxc_8807c43a1fa04a3e.text: If you chose a taxi, remember that Guam taxis use meters.

lxc_1978c2fecbdabb47.text: If you planned a courtesy transfer, remember that many Tumon hotels offer one, but confirmation matters.

lxc_c5e42c41f691726b.text: At the hotel, explain that you want to check in.

lxc_e7dfb2d2a24d3b0d.text: Give the name on your reservation clearly.

lxc_cd941968f4b4f98a.text: If you do not understand a question, ask the person to repeat it.

lxc_0f9db1a3fedf57b9.text: You can also share why you are visiting.

lxc_1d926fce3ff9defc.text: Perhaps you want a quiet holiday or time to explore.

lxc_6fdc3a72746914d0.text: A friendly conversation can happen while you finish your arrival.

lxc_6e3340810aedc0a1.text: A trip from Guam airport to a hotel can start with a taxi or a hotel transfer.

lxc_cee610144b72ba95.text: Clear questions help you choose your ride and start a friendly conversation.

lxc_0d7d403c4b4f50ef.text: Airport help conversation: You meet Leo, another traveler, near the car rental and tour counters by baggage claim at Guam airport.

lxc_dcbe13be49cdc05f.text: You want to call your hotel about a transfer using the hotel phones near the customs exit; both travelers' personal details are imagined.

lxc_4bd607cad9e26836.text: Your goal is to find the hotel phones and exchange a few friendly details about home, work, and travel plans.

lxc_cf0c76f5ce76ee16.text: Arrival conversation: You are explaining your travel plan to a friend before flying to Guam.

lxc_b454f079f571bb3f.text: Give a short spoken answer: choose a taxi or a hotel transfer, explain what you need to ask or confirm, and say how you will get help at the airport.

lxc_df4f34ca1189846e.text: Then share where you are from, what you do, and why you want to visit.

lxc_2871bdda3ce0169b.text: Use your own details, or clearly imagined ones.

lxc_514c4aa3766babcf.text: Finish with one friendly question for your friend.

lxc_54a991618fd4e0ea.text: Airport taxi conversation: You meet Maya, a taxi driver, at the counter outside West Arrival at Guam airport.

lxc_7ca7b8a175e6701a.text: Your destination is an unnamed hotel in Tumon, a short taxi ride away; your personal details in this conversation are imagined.

lxc_1b122590d70cdf3c.text: Your goal is to ask about the fare, agree on your destination, and share where you are from, what you do, and why you are visiting.

lxc_4f224ae445cbc862.text: “I'd like a taxi to my hotel, please.”

lxc_6b4abf4a21ca142c.text: “Could you explain the fare before we leave?”

lxc_6b78d73976383ebb.text: “Does my hotel offer an airport transfer?”

lxc_108e0022e3e53835.text: A travel conversation can begin with the trip you share.

lxc_ab29536c4e29f0b8.text: At Guam airport, you might meet another traveler near baggage claim.

lxc_f172a7aaf0f34f25.text: You might also talk while waiting near the taxi counter outside West Arrival.

lxc_62aa2717728c983f.text: Start with an easy question, such as where the person is from.

lxc_717b4243b728f8a9.text: Then share a little about yourself.

lxc_8c941735a4bfd7b9.text: You can talk about your work, your holiday, or your plans.

lxc_ef337e2fdc174d03.text: A short answer is enough; you do not need a long story.

lxc_d30d2fd58480926e.text: Ask another question when the person seems happy to talk.

lxc_3f943d2bdc1edb02.text: If they are tired, keep the conversation short.

lxc_817cc976986c167f.text: Friendly small talk gives both people space to speak.
